item.title: Plane Wi-Fi is not broken
item.description: 200 ms is a red flag at your desk and a good day at 38,000 feet. A connectivity monitor that cannot tell the difference is one you learn to ignore, including on the day it is right.

item.title: Four terminals, several tools, and no easy answer
item.description: Every time my Internet connection wavered, ping, traceroute and btop each gave me a glimpse of the problem and never the answer. So I built octomon.
